name: Dash status console
author: ktechmidas
description: Live state of the Dash test networks: every node with its Core and Platform versions, heights, sync and PoSe state, plus CI runner queues and open infrastructure faults. The read API is public JSON; a separate operator API runs network operations (upgrades, resets, devnets) with a token.
access: Reading is public: /api/networks/<name>, /api/nodes, /api/health, /api/ci, /api/ci/queue (CI jobs). Operator tokens are issued by a console admin; ask in #infra-claw.
